clips.title: The story
paras: Near Fargodeep Mine, Auntie Bernice Stonefield's necklace is missing, and the Stonefield and Maclure families blame each other. Billy Maclure admits he lost it while playing nearby, and you follow the trail to the kobold Goldtooth.

Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace has stirred up trouble between the Stonefield and Maclure families. Bernice suspects her rivals, but Billy Maclure lost the trinket while playing near Fargodeep Mine. He tries to hide his guilt, saying he only found the necklace before a creature snatched it away.

Billy says a large kobold with gleaming fangs took the shiny necklace and ran to a den above Fargodeep Mine. Goldtooth actually lurks on the mine's lower level. Slaying the kobold brings Bernice's necklace back, settles the families' dispute, and earns you an old campaign keepsake left by Bernice's late husband.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace. Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!
Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine. Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you found my necklace?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!
Here, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign!
